design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: IL Model Stormwater Management Ordinance / Illinois Urban Manual BMP framework. Site runoff controls for large storms through the 100-year event with post-development discharge rates not exceeding pre-development for specified events. Minor storm sewers/inlets/swales designed for the 10-year critical duration storm; BMPs per Illinois Urban Manual.
